findings.desc: Required smoke evidence is not runnable in REVIEW: npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke fails because the invalid checklist_update probe at packages/main/src/tasks/cli-surface-smoke.ts:160 runs with --root repoRoot while story B-a776 is in REVIEW, so the phase gate emits Command "checklist_update" is not available in REVIEW phase before the validation path. This invalidates the CHK-003 happy/edge smoke evidence for reviewer/TEST execution and leaves the advertised Argument validation failed path unproven in the active lifecycle phase.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3d0db5c86 by running the invalid checklist_update validation probe against an isolated temp --root/cwd, so argument validation is exercised before any active-story lifecycle gate. Evidence passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke; node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-argument-ergonomics-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/lattice-cli-migration-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; node bin/lattice.js scope_contract_check { storyId:B-a776, json:true }.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/cli-surface-smoke.ts:160-182: the new test:cli-surface-smoke verification is not phase-stable. In REVIEW, npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke fails because the invalid checklist_update probe is phase-gated before argument validation, printing Command checklist_update is not available in REVIEW phase instead of Argument validation failed. This means the parser/help/alias extraction evidence cannot be rerun from REVIEW/TEST and the adversarial validation check is coupled to lifecycle dispatch state; use a phase-neutral command/root or isolate the validation-path assertion from the active story phase gate.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3d0db5c86 by moving cli-surface-smoke invalid checklist_update validation to an isolated temp root/cwd. The smoke now asserts Argument validation failed and verificationIntent.happy.0.type while remaining stable from REVIEW/TEST. Evidence passed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; npm --prefix packages/main run test:cli-surface-smoke; npm --prefix packages/main run test:command-catalog-smoke; node packages/main/dist/tasks/cli-argument-ergonomics-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/lattice-cli-migration-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; node bin/lattice.js scope_contract_check { storyId:B-a776, json:true }.

findings.desc: packages/main/src/tasks/cli-surface-smoke.ts:139 hard-codes B-a776 for review_escalation_status; that command fails when the story id is absent, so this package smoke depends on this review story metadata surviving after merge or archive. Use a generated temporary story/context or choose a command path that does not require story-local metadata.
